themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can independently perform research tasks, autonomously explore data, and drive research processes.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers articles discussing specific AI-powered tools and platforms designed to assist in various research activities.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Explores AI tools that help developers write, debug, and optimize code, often integrated into development workflows.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Features articles on AI capabilities for condensing large volumes of text or data into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Discusses the effects of AI on jobs, employment, and the future of work, including research on displacement and new roles.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare the performance, features, and effectiveness of different AI tools for research purposes.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Focuses on the assessment and critique of AI tools, examining their usability, effectiveness, and limitations.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Covers the creation and use of artificial or simulated users for testing, research, or training AI systems.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Articles discussing comprehensive platforms designed to support and facilitate AI-driven research endeavors.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Examines how AI is used to automate, enhance, or analyze usability testing processes for products and services.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
